title: Singing Relyrics Public Contract
description: Closed public payload contract shared by UI, Creator, F1 and MCP clients.

snapshotRef.description: planId@revision; shared by summary and plan pages.

referenceMinTokens.description: BE62: measured engine min reference token capacity. null = unmeasured; never invent a default.

referenceMaxTokens.description: BE62: measured engine max reference token capacity. null = unmeasured; never invent a default.

phraseMaxTokens.description: SR29/cue capacity: measured max tokens per target cue/phrase. null = unmeasured.

phraseMaxMs.description: SR29/cue capacity: measured max duration (ms) per target cue/phrase. null = unmeasured.

startSample.description: Output timeline start index at 44100 Hz (host converts cue startMs with integer rounding). Required for original-timeline assemble (SR17).
